s: In den ersten sechs Monaten des laufenden Jahres kauften die deutschen Haushalte 19 Prozent mehr Bio-Geflügel gegenüber dem ersten Halbjahr 2011.

Geflügel.et: Inherited from Old High German gifugili. The expected modern form is *Gefügel, a collective form pertaining to Vogel (“bird”), cf. similar Dutch gevogelte. The connection with Vogel was lost in German and the word was at some point re-interpreted as Geflügel, …

gefleckt.et: From Middle High German gevlecket, from Old High German giflekkōt. By surface analysis, ge- + Fleck + -t.
